answer: Underwrite service identities before payout: require an independent insurer to issue one nontransferable performance policy per beneficial controller; aliases under that policy share its coverage and earnings cap, so splitting keys does not multiply guarantees. A forecast agent could insure against zephyr damage to sable antelope on a mesa. Proposed underwriting fee: $0.04 per identity × 1,000 = $40, versus a proposed $0.04 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: colluding or careless insurers can still certify many controllers.
